analysis.summary: One Global Service Provider Limited published its 33rd Annual Report for the financial year 2024-25, highlighting strategic transformation, business expansion into IT consultancy and software solutions, and an increase in total revenue to Rs. 14,784.17 lakhs alongside a net profit of Rs. 1,846.66 lakhs. The company completed a scheme of amalgamation with Plus Care Internationals Private Limited, which impacted its financial statements and capital structure. Management emphasized the company's commitment to preventive and precision healthcare, a unified online platform acting as a 'One-Stop Solution', and adherence to strong corporate governance frameworks.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that initial performance in the new IT segment is modest.
demand_outlook.quote: While our initial performance in this new segment is modest, we are confident that with perseverance, innovation, and strategic partnerships, we will achieve sustainable growth and market success.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors did not recommend any dividend for the financial year 2024-25.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board of Directors has not recommended any dividend for the financial year 2024-25.

capital_allocation.claim: The company reported no transfers to the General Reserve for the year under review.
capital_allocation.quote: There has been no transfers to the General Reserve of the Company for the year under review.

capital_allocation.claim: The company has not accepted any public deposits within the meaning of Section 73 of the Companies Act, 2013.
capital_allocation.quote: The Company has not accepted any deposits from the public within the meaning of Section 73 of the Companies Act, 2013 read with the Companies (Acceptance of Deposits) Rules, 2014.

capital_allocation.claim: The board recommended a dividend of Rs. 1 per share on 71,04,707 equity shares of Rs. 10 each.
capital_allocation.quote: Based on the Company’s performance, the Board recommended a dividend of ` Rs. 1 per share on 71,04,707 equity shares of ` 10 each, subject to the approval of the Members.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of the Company did not recommend any dividend for the year under review.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board of the Company did not recommend any dividend for the year under review.
